summary: Extracts a player/.plr filename into the output buffer a2. First attempts to read a string length from the game module manager via NullTerminatedStringLengthAt0x11c(dword_7CD25C); when non-zero, that string is copied into a2 with a length limit of a3-1. Otherwise the object's own name string is recovered via ShortComputation_0b10, trimmed to the portion after the last backslash, truncated at the '.plr' suffix match found by sub_566810, and copied into a2 with the same length limit.

operations.description: Call NullTerminatedStringLengthAt0x11c(dword_7CD25C) to get the module-manager string length into v4.
If v4 is non-zero, use the module-manager path: copy via sub_587DD0(a2, v4, a3 - 1) and terminate the output at a2[a3 - 1] = 0.
Otherwise clear the output buffer with *a2 = 0.
Recover the object name string via ShortComputation_0b10(this) and copy it into the local v10 buffer.
Advance v9 to the start of the filename after the last backslash (0x5C) in the local name copy; if none is found keep v9 at the buffer start.
Call sub_566810(v9, aPlr) to locate the '.plr' suffix; if found, terminate the string there.
Copy the resulting filename via sub_587DD0(a2, v9, a3 - 1) and terminate the output at a2[a3 - 1] = 0.
Return the result of the last copy/write operation.
